pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Dialog (Modal) pattern implemented with native <dialog>.showModal(); non-modal drawers use <dialog>.show() as a non-modal dialog.

aria.value: Implicit true for modal drawers (native showModal()); absent for non-modal drawers

keyboard.action: Moves focus among drawer controls; the background is inert (native modal).
Follows document order; focus can leave the drawer and reach the page.

keyboard.context: Drawer is the topmost overlay, closeOnEscape=true
keyboard.action: Emits cancelable aui-cancel, then closes and restores focus.
No effect; the native close request is prevented, including repeated presses.

focus: On open, focus moves to the autofocus action or first focusable element. On close, a modal drawer returns focus to the element focused before opening; a non-modal drawer does so only when focus was inside the drawer, so users working in the page keep their place.
notes: Background inertness and top-layer rendering of modal drawers are provided by the browser.
Slide motion is removed under prefers-reduced-motion and data-aui-animation='none'.
Use non-modal drawers only for supplementary panels (filters, details).
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
